priorities.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind OS command injection attack and execute arbitrary commands. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 25 as exploited, with federal remediation due November 28; the fix is the KB000129195 patch on 10.3.0.18 or a later release.
priorities.plain: Mitel MiCollab lets an attacker with no login run commands and take over the conferencing server, and it is being exploited - patch now.

priorities.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication by sending an empty JSON object as a login cookie and perform administrative actions. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 25 as exploited; Vates fixes it in Xen Orchestra 6.9.2 and 6.10.1 (xo-server 5.211.2 and 5.213.1).
priorities.plain: Vates Xen Orchestra lets an attacker with no login act as an administrator over the virtual machines it manages - update now.

priorities.summary: HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner component: a remote attacker using a specially crafted salt minion ID can execute arbitrary commands as root without authentication. Juniper confirmed exploitation on November 24 and CISA added it to KEV on November 25; fixed releases are 7.0.5, 7.1.7 and 7.2.3 under JSA112183.
priorities.plain: HPE Juniper Session Smart lets an attacker with no login take full control of the network router, and it is being exploited - upgrade now.
priorities.product: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router

model.name: Mellum2.1 Instruct
model.summary: JetBrains released Mellum2.1 Instruct on November 25, the non-reasoning sibling of Mellum2.1 Thinking, built for coding sub-agents, tool loops and chat. It is open-weight under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, with GGUF builds and an MTP head for faster local generation.
model.plain: JetBrains' open coding AI gives development teams a fast, self-hosted helper for everyday coding tasks inside their own tools.
